title: MyLinden Help: Automatic-Debit Months on a Patient Payment Plans Term Extension
content:
**Does paying by automatic debit add months when an add-on lengthens my Patient Payment Plans term?**

The automatic-debit months of the extension are 2 when the plan's automatic debit method is ACH and at least 6 installments have been paid on the plan; 1 when the method is card or HSA/FSA card and at least 6 installments have been paid; and 0 in every other case.

**How do these months count?** They are added to the extension months together with the rounded add-on share, and the total is then held within the room left (the tier's maximum term-extension months less the extension months already used) and is never below 0.

| Automatic debit method on the plan | Installments paid on the plan | Automatic-debit months |
|---|---|---|
| ACH | 6 or more | 2 |
| ACH | Fewer than 6 | 0 |
| Card or HSA/FSA card | 6 or more | 1 |
| Card or HSA/FSA card | Fewer than 6 | 0 |
| None | Any | 0 |

**Examples (hypothetical).** A plan paying by ACH with exactly 6 installments paid earns 2 months; with 5 paid it earns 0. A plan paying by HSA/FSA card with 9 installments paid earns 1.
